scenes.picture: Chidi sitting on his sofa in the living room, wearing a brand new crisp white designer shirt, eating hot amala and ewedu soup with palm oil directly from a plate on his laps while rushing to type on his laptop.
scenes.dialogue: Ah, deadline dey pursue me! Make I chop quick before I join zoom meeting!
scenes.caption: Chidi wan break world record for multi-tasking.

scenes.picture: A close up of the scene as a heavy drop of red palm oil slips off Chidi's meat and falls in slow motion straight onto the center of his expensive white shirt.
scenes.dialogue: Jesus! E gbami! My brand new white shirt!
scenes.caption: The oil don find where e belong.

scenes.picture: Chidi panicking, standing up abruptly and spilling the remaining ewedu soup all over the expensive living room rug and the grey sofa cushions.
scenes.dialogue: Wetin be dis again?! Everywhere don red and green!
scenes.caption: From shirt disaster to full room accident.

scenes.picture: Chidi sweating profusely, trying to scrub the oil stains with a small kitchen sponge and ordinary bathing soap while shouting in frustration.
scenes.dialogue: Abeg stain,comot for my body! Why you stubborn like this?
scenes.caption: Local man thinks bathing soap can fight palm oil.

scenes.picture: Aunty Ngozi entering the living room, holding her head with both hands in shock as she looks at the massive mess on the shirt, rug and sofa.
scenes.dialogue: Chidi! You turn your parlour to local canteen abi? See as everywhere dirty!
scenes.caption: Aunty Ngozi don come live to judge.

scenes.picture: A neat and smiling Neat Naija attendant in a green uniform and glasses standing in the clean living room, holding sparkling clean clothes and fresh equipment while Chidi relaxes happily on the spotless sofa.
scenes.dialogue: No worry Chidi, Neat Naija don take over the matter!
scenes.caption: Laundry, house, office, sofa and carpet cleaning. DM to book.
